_note: Upcoming AI dates. status: confirmed | rumored. Never add a date without a source. ai_intel.py calendar drops past items automatically.

items.name: Next Anthropic (Claude) model — estimated window
items.why: Forecast sites expect a new Claude soon. Claude is one of the best for writing and coding, so a new one usually means better results for the same price.

items.name: Next Google Gemini model — estimated window
items.why: Google ships often and many Gemini features are free. A new model can mean stronger free tools for content and research.

items.name: GitHub Universe (San Francisco + online)
items.why: GitHub's yearly show. Expect new Copilot / AI coding agent features: building apps and bots without being a pro coder keeps getting easier.

items.name: Next OpenAI (ChatGPT) model — estimated window
items.why: Forecasts point to a new OpenAI release in this window. New ChatGPT models usually land for millions of users on day one.

items.name: Web Summit (Lisbon)
items.why: One of the biggest tech/startup events. Lots of AI startup launches and funding news drop here: good for spotting new tools early.

items.name: AI Engineer Code Summit (San Francisco)
items.why: Focused on AI coding agents. Shows where 'AI builds the software for you' is heading next.

items.name: NVIDIA Q3 earnings (after market close)
items.why: NVIDIA sells the chips that power almost all AI. Its numbers move AI stocks and often AI crypto tokens. Expect volatility that night.

items.name: Microsoft Ignite (San Francisco + online)
items.why: Microsoft's big yearly show. Expect Copilot and AI agent updates for Windows, Office and Teams: the tools most businesses use every day.

items.name: Claude Sonnet 4.5 retired from the Claude API
items.why: Apps still using this old model stop working. If you run bots or automations on it, switch to Claude Sonnet 5.5 before this date.

items.name: AWS re:Invent (Las Vegas)
items.why: Amazon's biggest cloud + AI event. New AI tools for businesses get announced here, and cheaper AI infrastructure usually follows.

items.name: NeurIPS (Sydney; satellites in Atlanta & Paris)
items.why: The biggest AI research conference. The ideas shown here turn into the apps everyone uses next year.

items.name: The AI Summit New York
items.why: Big business-AI event. Shows what companies are actually paying for: useful for spotting AI services you could sell.
